name: isometric-build
title: Isometric Build
description: An isometric tile grid springs up row by row into a stepped block sculpture with one accent tower, then holds.
useWhen: An opener or section break should build something in about a second, a small city or stack that reads as infrastructure, platform or growth.
A product story about building, scaling or assembling needs a flat, monochrome isometric visual with one highlighted piece.
A beat should end on a still, composed object that can hold under a title or a caption.
avoidWhen: The stack should come apart to explain layers, with labels: use exploded-view.
The blocks should rebuild a logo or pixel art: use brick-mosaic.
The build should be flat 2D shapes rather than isometric volume: use bauhaus-build.
author: Remocn
